Achieving this will unlock more effective, trustworthy AI applications in health, finance, and beyond, where raw data sharing is prohibited or risky. arguments.content: Our approach leverages privacy-scoped personalization techniques with auditable sharing mechanisms to ensure model adaptation across dispersed environments. By using lightweight adapter modules, we enable efficient local personalization while maintaining strong privacy guarantees. We also incorporate risk assessments to address potential adapter inversion attacks without exposing operational attack procedure details or enforcement mechanisms.
